notes: Controlled vocabulary for the `tags` field. Every entry must pick 2-5 tags, all from this list. Entries found to need a new tag should propose it here first (see `proposed` section). Reviewed and expanded in parallel with the build — this is v0 drafted during walk_to_walken.
rules: Every entry gets at least one DOMAIN tag and at least one THEME tag.
FIGURE tags are optional — add when the quote is strongly associated with a named person or tradition.
FORM tags describe the shape of the source (proverb, speech, scripture). Optional but useful for filtering.
MOOD tags describe emotional register — add when it helps the app filter for tone (funny, dark, uplifting).
